law.carrier: write B to ACEF, then C to ACEE; reread both before SHLD AC9F
law.entry: hardware CALL from PLI2.OVL+2492; mutable return word at SP
law.flags: ANA AC and DAD carry computed; final SBB flags exact
law.mask: A=7 ANA fresh [HL]; SUI 0; SUI 1; SBB A using immediate prior borrow
law.pointer: fresh carrier word plus 3 modulo 65536, DAD carry exact
